desc: huge upright swamp crocodile with gaping fanged jaws a spiny back ridge and heavy tail
ref_note: RE-PICK (Oggdo Bogdo is Oggdo art, wooper/quagsire canon). Original; same ghest drawing as the rest of the line at full 64 px height. Scrange (wide rearing croc) was the alternative but came out lower than croconaw. Uncoloured line art.
